新增:
楼中楼图片
楼层下的回复中，图片显示为「查看图片」，点按即可查看；楼中楼页中直接显示图片

动态与消息页搜索
搜索栏位于首页顶部时，动态与消息页的顶栏显示搜索按钮

自动刷新「动态」
在「浏览」中关闭后，打开应用时显示上次加载的推荐与关注，下拉即可刷新
改进:
吧规与置顶
吧规移至「关于本吧」，点按吧名即可打开；置顶帖可收起，收起后只显示第一条与总数

帖子中的链接
读屏与键盘可以找到帖子中的链接、@ 与话题

楼层排版
同一楼的名字、正文、时间与楼中楼排得更紧凑，楼与楼之间留出更清楚的间隔，与有无楼中楼无关
修复: 底栏收起后，切换页面或返回时意外展开
标签较多时，标签栏无法左右滑动
按住标签栏、分段控件或底栏时，玻璃边缘出现残缺的文字
帖子内容更新后，点按链接偶尔打开其他链接
楼中楼的「展开其余」只能点按文字
打开推荐中的回复时提示主题不存在
打开网页时切换到后台偶尔闪退
帖子页中滑动关闭提示条时偶尔闪退

New:
Pictures in replies
Under a floor, a reply's pictures show as View image, which opens them; the replies page shows them in place

Search from Explore and Inbox
With search at the top of Home, Explore and Inbox show a search button in their bars

Refresh “Explore” on open
Turn it off under Browsing and For you and Following show what was last loaded when the app opens; pull down to refresh
Improved:
Rules and pinned threads
A forum's rules are now in About this forum, which its name opens; pinned threads can fold to the first one and their count

Links in posts
Screen readers and keyboards can reach the links, mentions and topics in posts

Floor layout
A floor's name, text, time and replies sit closer together, and floors are set clearly apart, with or without replies
Fixed: The folded bottom bar unfolded when switching tabs or going back
A row of many tabs couldn't be scrolled sideways
Holding a tab row, segmented control or the bottom bar showed cut-off text at the glass's edge
Tapping a link after a post updated occasionally opened another link
Only the words of “Show N more” under replies could be tapped
Opening a reply from For you said the thread didn't exist
The app occasionally crashed when sent to the background with a web page open
Swiping away a notice in a thread occasionally crashed the app
